categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Kaibao Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of modern traditional Chinese medicines. The company focuses on three main product lines: respiratory system (represented by patented Phlegm-Heat Clearing Injection and capsules), cardiovascular system (represented by Qishen Capsules), and digestive system (represented by Sulfur Pronine series). It also operates subsidiaries specializing in pharmaceutical sales, equity investment, and healthcare technology.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced pharmaceutical manufacturing technologies including fingerprint spectrum detection for quality control of traditional Chinese medicine injections. It operates GMP-certified production lines for injections, freeze-dried powders, sterile water injections, and oral formulations. The production process is highly automated and digitized with real-time monitoring and full traceability to ensure product quality and safety.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include hospitals and medical institutions across China, with products included in the National Basic Medical Insurance Drug Catalog. The company serves clinical departments such as internal medicine, surgery, pediatrics, infectious diseases, oncology, and ICU. Its products are used for treatment and prevention of respiratory diseases, cardiovascular conditions, and digestive ailments.
categories.geographic_coverage: Shanghai Kaibao operates primarily within China, with sales covering all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities. The company has established regional sales teams in the North, East, South, and West districts of China, with the North region contributing the largest revenue share.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream pharmaceutical manufacturing segment, encompassing drug R&D, production, and distribution. It maintains an independent supply chain for raw materials procurement, production, and sales, supported by subsidiaries handling sales and equity investments to expand product lines and market reach.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes modernization and innovation of traditional Chinese medicine, focusing on core patented products and their secondary development to expand indications. It invests in R&D platforms, collaborates with academic institutions, and pursues new drug development including clinical trials for multiple products. The company also explores the health and wellness sector to diversify its portfolio.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of pharmaceutical drugs, including patented injections, capsules, and tablets. The company sells mainly via direct sales and distribution channels to hospitals and medical institutions. It also earns income from government subsidies, investment returns, and licensing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shanghai Kaibao is positioned as a leading modern traditional Chinese medicine manufacturer with strong patented products and recognized clinical efficacy. It holds a competitive edge in respiratory and cardiovascular therapeutic areas. The company faces competition from other domestic pharmaceutical firms but leverages its innovation, quality control, and academic marketing to maintain market leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.47 billion, a slight decline of 7.57% from the previous year, while net profit attributable to shareholders increased by 14.55% to RMB 375.58 million. The company maintains a solid asset base of over RMB 4.5 billion and continues to invest significantly in R&D, with expenditures around RMB 99.79 million, representing 6.77% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Kaibao emphasizes its unique patented products with proven clinical efficacy and safety, especially the Phlegm-Heat Clearing Injection used in major infectious disease treatments and included in national clinical guidelines. The company differentiates itself through advanced manufacturing technologies, stringent quality control, and a professional academic marketing approach that builds strong brand recognition and trust among healthcare providers.
